invariants.rationale: The method sets properties and fetches tiles from tileSet, so it cannot be null.
The properties object returned by tileSet.getProperties() is used for multiple assignments.
tilewidth and tileheight are divisors when computing number of tiles, so must be strictly positive.
Image width and height are used as bounds for logical tile layout and should not be negative.
The method iterates over tileElements, so it cannot be null.
